comment: Every difference between the retained baseline 66ee4657-supplement-v1 and the working tree,
named. `make check-compat` refuses a difference that is not named here and a name here that
matches no difference. A change to this file is a review event.
constructor_additions: a new constructor. Its tag was never held in the baseline.
constructor_retirements: a constructor that left. Its row moved to the retired rows of
tools/Effect4Gen/wire-tags.json at the same tag, and the tag is never given again.
family_additions: a family newly reached from the retained roots.
family_retirements: a family that left the program world. Its lines leave the generated
manifests and its count rows leave the coverage table; its rows stay in
tools/Effect4Gen/wire-tags.json, so its tags are reserved and never given again.
consumer_additions: a family newly selected by a codec group or by the program world.
vector_removals and vector_migrations: retained byte vectors (paths of
66ee4657/golden-digests.sha256, relative to ocaml/) that no longer exist or changed bytes.
historical_renumbering: the one reuse of tags, from before tags were assigned. At 75d75fdb
`Eff.choose` (tag 23) was removed and the three constructors after it moved down by one,
so `catchIf`, appended earlier at 27, landed on 26. Programs that use `provideLayer`,
`service`, `provideService` or `catchIf` encoded before that commit do not decode to the
same program today. Three retained vectors moved with it and the `choose` vector went.
Since S1 the tags are assigned in tools/Effect4Gen/wire-tags.json and this cannot recur.
The Eff series (DI-79). `branch` retired into `select` under the `bool` decision: tag 15 is
retired, old bytes of a `branch` refuse, and the three retained vectors that held one
(pBranch, pIllBranch, pIllJoin) are the same programs written with `select`.
`yieldError` retired into `fail`, the failure it meant: tag 3 is retired, old bytes refuse,
and pYieldError is the same program written with `fail`.
The state plan's T3a (decisions rows 42, 155 (a), 183, 209). `Deferred.make` carries its type
arguments: `NativeOp.deferredMake` retired at tag 13 and `NativeOp.deferredMakeOf (value error : Ty)`
appended at tag 23. The retained vectors that perform it (pAwait, pCallback, pOps) are the same
programs at `deferredMakeOf nat nat`, and pAcquire's checked answer is `refOf nat`, the type the
retired cell spelling denoted. verdict_moves names each corpus row whose verdict moved, as
`path:key`: g158 (`Ref.make("hi")`) types at `Ref<string>`, and g277's first refusal moved from
`Ref.make(a0)` to the term `lt(9, undefined)` after it.
The host lane's table followed at the sweep of 2026-10-05 (`50700443`): g158 now runs and
agrees, and g309's note names the declared type that the printed module now carries. Its
verdict did not move.
The state plan's T3b (decisions rows 42, 43, 210, 228). The eight read-modify-write `Ref` rows
carry a binder term: `NativeOp.refUpdate` … `refModifySome (f : FnName)` retired at tags 5 to 12
and `NativeOp.refUpdateWith` … `refModifySomeWith (f : Term)` appended at tags 24 to 31. No
program names a function any more, so the family `Effect4.Machine.FnName` left the program
world (family_retirements); the five names stay the faces' spelling of five terms per shape
(`FnName.image`, src/Effect4/Program/FnName.lean). Old bytes of a retired row refuse. The
retained vectors that perform such a row (pOps, and pLoop of the wire corpus) are the same
programs with each name's image at its node's level. No corpus verdict moved.
The list fold (decisions rows 228, 229). `Term.fold (accTy : Option Ty) (list init body : Term)`
appended at tag 7 of `Effect4.Program.Term`. No tag moved and no constructor left. The three
atoms `take`, `drop` and `sameHandle` are spelled by name on the wire, so they add no tag. No
retained vector changed bytes: eight golden programs were appended to the OCaml corpus (pFold,
pFoldCapture, pFoldNested, pFoldInOp, pFoldAtoms, pIllFoldNotList, pIllFoldBody,
pIllSameHandle). No corpus verdict moved.
The integer rows (decisions row 319; the integers packet, slice 5). The atoms `plus` and
`minus` (`NativeAtom.intAdd`, `NativeAtom.intSub`) are appended after `sameHandle`, and `lt`
and `eq` take `int`. Atoms are spelled by name on the wire, so they add no tag and no retained
vector changed bytes. Each printed module of the truth group imports the two names, and no
corpus verdict moved.
The faces of a binder term and the literal rule (the state plan's T5; decisions rows 43, 212
and 256). The host lane's table followed at the merge of 2026-10-06 (`1eadc78b`): 21 rows
moved, each in one column, and no verdict column moved. Fourteen moved in the note, the
compiler's message on a program that Lean does not type: it shows `Ref<unknown>` where it
showed `Ref<number>`, because a row's term prints as a function of the current value and no
longer as a named function (g61, g94, g124, g127, g147, g154, g169, g239, g246, g259, g294,
g298, g345, g379). Two moved in the note for the literal rule: the message shows a tuple's
wide type (g5, g167). Five moved in the host's answer: the program is `Effect.fiberId`, and
the host's fiber counter stands at 7 where it stood at 1 (g81, g144, g250, g289, g313). Each
of the five was a registered difference before, and it is the same difference.
The mask's saved state (decisions rows 244 to 246; seat MASK's first step, merged
`811ac973`). `Eff.restore` appended at tag 29 of `Effect4.Program.Eff`, and
`ActionTerm.getInterruptible` at tag 16 of `Effect4.Program.ActionTerm`. No tag moved and no
constructor left. No retained vector changed bytes: fifteen golden files were appended to
the OCaml corpus, for the programs pMask, pMaskNested, pMaskEscape, pIllRestoreBool and
pIllMaskAsBool. No corpus verdict moved.
The truth lane's fiber numbers (decisions row 274; seat PUB's repair, merged `5701a5dc`). The
Lean face writes a fiber under its number in the recorder's order of first sight, and no
longer under the machine's id. The host lane's table followed at that merge: two rows moved,
each in one column, and no verdict column moved. g102 moved in its Lean schedule: fifteen
rows take other fiber numbers, and the row was a registered difference before. g246 moved in
its Lean exit, from `{"fiber":1}` to `{"fiber":2}`: the program is ill typed, and the host
does not run it. g246 was named before, for its note.
The exit column of the truth lane's runner (decisions row 279, point 1). The column compares
the fork entry on both faces, and no longer rc.112's sync exit where the sync run settles. The
host lane's table followed at that change: six rows moved, each named before, and no outcome
moved. Five moved in the host's answer: the program is `Effect.fiberId`, and the host's fiber
counter stands at 8 on the fork entry where it stands at 7 on the sync entry (g81, g144, g250,
g289, g313). The note of each now gives the sync entry's exit. g102 moved in its note alone: it
loses the sentence on the fork entry. Each of the six was a registered difference before, on
both dimensions, and it is the same difference (DI-73).
Chunk 3 (2026-10-07, decisions row 306): eleven tests of the checker at a fixed type read the
order, so a test at the type `never` is accepted. One row of the corpus index moved in its
address column, and no verdict column moved. g85 is refused with `predicateNotBool` as
before. Its address was the root, the test of a `catchIf` whose body cannot fail. It is now
`1.0`, the test `7` of the inner loop, which is where tsgo 7 reports its one error (TS2322).
A row's trailing arguments (2026-10-09): `Row.trailing` holds `RowArg`, a name or a string
literal, where it held strings, so `Scope.make("parallel")`'s strategy prints as a literal
and not as a name. The family `RowArg` is new, with `name` (tag 0) and `str` (tag 1). The
row's encoding moves only where a trailing list is not empty: no retained byte vector holds
one (C1 passes), and the metadata fixture `row-populated` is re-encoded. That is no append:
C2 refuses the re-typed field `Row.trailing` and C3 the fixture's line, and this policy has
no name for either. The change is the owner's to accept as a non-conservative row encoding.
